# FlagBLAS sgemm Core Shape 性能基准报告（nn / tn / nt / tt）

> 日期：2026-09-02
> 运行命令：`pytest benchmark/test_sgemm_perf.py --level core -v -s`（--record log）
> 环境：Hygon gfx936（80 CU）/ DTK / Triton 3.6 / torch 2.4.1
> 测试：hipBLAS（torch latency）vs FlagBLAS（gems latency），`do_bench(warmup=1000, rep=100, median)`，speedup = ref/flag

---

## 1. 汇总

| 变体 | shapes | 正确性 | median speedup | 最高 speedup | 最低 speedup | speedup≥0.95 | speedup≥0.90 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| sgemm_nn | 37 | ALL PASS | 0.9556 | 1.1707 | 0.7257 | 19 | 31 |
| sgemm_tn | 37 | ALL PASS | 0.9760 | 1.9655 | 0.8203 | 24 | 33 |
| sgemm_nt | 37 | ALL PASS | 0.9272 | 1.1519 | 0.7279 | 11 | 25 |
| sgemm_tt | 37 | ALL PASS | 1.1340 | 1.7565 | 0.9559 | 37 | 37 |
